title: decision-evidence-policy-version-mismatch

proposition.statement: A relying system must not represent a trust decision as satisfying one policy or policy version when the material evidence or evaluation was actually produced under a different, incompatible, or unidentified policy context.

preconditions: A relying decision asserts compliance with an identified policy or policy version.
Material evidence or evaluation results were produced under another policy context, or their policy context cannot be established.
No compatibility rule establishes that the evidence remains valid under the asserted policy context.

trigger.statement: The relying system consumes evidence or a prior decision without reconciling the policy context under which that evidence was produced with the policy asserted for the current decision.

evidence_required.statement: Evidence identifying the policy or policy version asserted for the current decision and the policy context used to produce material evidence.
Evidence linking the material evaluation or evidence artifact to the policy context under which it was produced.
Evidence sufficient to determine whether a policy change occurred between evidence production and the current decision.

falsification.condition: The system returns PASS while representing compliance with policy version B from evidence materially evaluated only under incompatible policy version A.
The system cannot establish the policy context of material evidence but attributes that evidence to the current asserted policy and returns PASS.

references.note: Repository judgment record for the evidence failure tranche.
